standard_prerequisites.name: The definition of a local property of ring maps with its conditions (a) on standard localizations of the target, (b) on standard localizations of the source and (c) on finite covers of the source
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cited repeatedly at proof lines 2687, 2696, 2699 and 2704
standard_prerequisites.use: Every shrinking step in the proof is an application of one of these three conditions.

standard_prerequisites.name: Two affine opens of a scheme with a common point have a common neighbourhood that is standard affine open in both, cited from the schemes chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the standard affine neighbourhoods used to invoke conditions (a) and (b) of locality.

standard_prerequisites.name: An affine scheme is quasi-compact, so a cover of it by open pieces has a finite subcover
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the pointwise reductions into a finite cover to which condition (c) of locality can be applied.

core_obligations: For a point u of U, use that f is locally of type P to find an affine open U_u mapping into an affine open V_u with P holding, then replace U_u by a neighbourhood that is standard affine open in both U and U_u and keep P by condition (b) of locality (proof lines 2681-2690).

Shrink the target as well: choose a neighbourhood V'_u of f(u) that is standard affine open in both V and V_u, set U'_u equal to the intersection of the preimage of V'_u with U_u, which is standard affine open in U_u, and keep P by condition (a) of locality (proof lines 2690-2697).
Apply condition (b) once more to conclude that P holds for the ring map from the coordinate ring of V to the coordinate ring of U_u (proof lines 2697-2700).

Finish with quasi-compactness: choose finitely many points whose U_{u_i} cover U and apply condition (c) of locality to the pair (V, U) to obtain P for the coordinate ring map of the given affine opens (proof lines 2700-2709).
proof_roadmap: Reduce pointwise to standard affine neighbourhoods inside the given pair of affine opens, using conditions (a) and (b) of locality twice (proof lines 2681-2700).
Cover the quasi-compact affine open U by finitely many of these pieces and apply condition (c) of locality (proof lines 2700-2709).
difficulty_reason: The lemma transfers a local property of ring maps from a local-on-the-source hypothesis to an arbitrary pair of affine opens U inside X with image in V inside S (statement lines 2670-2679). The counted proof is a two-parameter shrinking argument: it first replaces the witnessing affine opens by standard affine neighbourhoods inside the given pair, using conditions (a) and (b) of locality twice, then covers the quasi-compact affine open U by finitely many witnesses and applies condition (c) (proof lines 2681-2709). It is H2: the argument is complete and consists of correctly nesting the three locality conditions, with no independent research-level content.
